project.name: Cardigan
project.summary: Kanban app (boards, columns, cards, labels) with a Kotlin Spring Boot backend, a Compose Multiplatform app for Android and iOS, and a responsive React web app.

chunks.title: Behavioral shared specs
chunks.summary: Cross-platform behavioral specs (OpenSpec) for the domain model, text limits, ordering, auth, boards, columns, cards, labels and board import/export, including the export file format. The wire-level API contract is not part of this: the backend generates it code-first.
chunks.doneWhen: Every v1 feature has a shared behavioral spec that backend and both clients can implement against.

chunks.title: Backend scaffolding & architecture
chunks.summary: Spring Boot (Kotlin) project, package/module layout, Postgres connection (local + Supabase via config), migration tooling, logging, health endpoint, Dockerfile and CI build/test.
chunks.doneWhen: Service boots locally against Postgres with an empty migration, exposes a health endpoint, and CI builds and tests it.

chunks.title: Backend common utilities
chunks.summary: Cross-cutting backend foundation: security filter chain with JWT verification and current-user principal, users table, global error handling per the shared error model, request validation, SpringDoc with an exported OpenAPI spec, and test helpers for authenticated requests.
chunks.doneWhen: A sample protected endpoint rejects missing/invalid tokens, returns errors in the shared model, and appears in the exported OpenAPI spec; tests can call it as a given user.

chunks.title: Backend authentication
chunks.summary: Registration, login, refresh and logout: password hashing, issuing 15-minute JWT access tokens, 30-day refresh tokens with rotation and revocation.
chunks.doneWhen: Integration tests cover register, login, refresh, logout, duplicate email, wrong password and expired/revoked refresh tokens; endpoints appear in the OpenAPI spec.

chunks.title: Backend boards & columns
chunks.summary: Per-user boards and their columns with CRUD, board keys, column ordering and ownership scoping.
chunks.doneWhen: Integration tests cover board and column CRUD, column moves, key rules and ownership isolation per the shared specs.

chunks.title: Backend labels
chunks.summary: User-defined labels with CRUD, case-insensitive unique names and palette colors.
chunks.doneWhen: Integration tests cover label CRUD, name uniqueness, palette validation and ownership isolation.

chunks.title: Backend cards, ordering & card labels
chunks.summary: Cards inside columns with CRUD, per-board numbering, moves within and across columns, and attaching/detaching labels; deleting a label removes it from cards.
chunks.doneWhen: Integration tests cover card CRUD, numbering, same- and cross-column moves with dense positions, label attach/detach and ownership isolation.

chunks.title: Backend board import/export
chunks.summary: Blocking download of a complete board as JSON and blocking upload that validates the file and recreates the board for the current user.
chunks.doneWhen: Round-trip test: an exported board imported into another account is equivalent; invalid files are rejected with shared-model errors; import is atomic.

chunks.title: VPS infrastructure & deployment
chunks.summary: Provision the production VPS: container runtime, reverse proxy with TLS serving the web build and the API, secrets, Supabase Postgres connection, backups/monitoring basics, CD for backend and web, and a production smoke test of both clients.
chunks.doneWhen: A push to main deploys backend and web over HTTPS, and all v1 flows pass a smoke test on web and on Android/iOS against production.

chunks.title: Mobile scaffolding & architecture
chunks.summary: Compose Multiplatform project for Android and iOS, isolated feature module structure, base architecture (MVI, DI), navigation shell, app-wide utilities (result/error types, UiText, dispatchers, logging), a core domain module (Board, Column, Card, Label, User, text-length counting and field limits) and CI build.
chunks.doneWhen: App launches on Android and iOS with a placeholder screen and navigation shell; CI builds both targets.

chunks.title: Mobile design system
chunks.summary: Theme, tokens (colors, typography, spacing, light/dark), base components incl. label chips, and adaptive layout helpers for phone and tablet.
chunks.doneWhen: Theme and base components exist with previews and are used by a sample screen on both platforms.

chunks.title: Mobile API client foundation
chunks.summary: Code generation from the backend's exported OpenAPI spec, Ktor client configuration, mapping of the shared error model into the app's result/error types, and base URL per build environment.
chunks.doneWhen: Generated client code builds for Android and iOS and a call to the sample protected endpoint maps success and error responses correctly.

chunks.title: Mobile auth UI
chunks.summary: Register and login screens with ViewModels, form validation per the shared specs, and the auth repository interface; tested with test doubles.
chunks.doneWhen: Register and login screens show every state on Android and iOS, phone and tablet; ViewModel tests pass against test doubles.

chunks.title: Mobile board list UI
chunks.summary: Board overview with create, rename and delete, loading/empty/error states, intentional refresh, and the boards repository interface.
chunks.doneWhen: Board list shows every state on Android and iOS, phone and tablet; ViewModel tests pass against test doubles.

chunks.title: Mobile board view UI
chunks.summary: Board screen with columns and card tiles, layouts per screen size, column create/rename/delete, column move buttons and intentional refresh.
chunks.doneWhen: A sample board renders correctly on Android and iOS, phone and tablet; column actions work in ViewModel tests against test doubles.

chunks.title: Mobile card detail UI
chunks.summary: Card create, view, edit and delete with adaptive presentation (sheet on narrow screens, dialog/side panel on wide ones) and the cards repository interface.
chunks.doneWhen: Card detail shows every state on Android and iOS, phone and tablet; ViewModel tests pass against test doubles.

chunks.title: Mobile labels UI
chunks.summary: Label management (create, edit, delete with palette colors) and a reusable label picker for cards, plus the labels repository interface.
chunks.doneWhen: Label management and picker show every state on Android and iOS, phone and tablet; ViewModel tests pass against test doubles.

chunks.title: Mobile import/export UI & file handling
chunks.summary: Export and import actions with blocking progress and error states, plus platform file access (share sheet / save, file picker) on Android and iOS.
chunks.doneWhen: A JSON file can be picked and saved/shared on both platforms, and progress/error states show correctly; ViewModel tests pass against test doubles.

chunks.title: Mobile card drag & drop
chunks.summary: Drag & drop of cards within and across columns with auto-scroll and drop indicators, emitting moves through the cards repository interface with rollback on failure.
chunks.doneWhen: Cards can be dragged within and across columns on Android and iOS, phone and tablet; failed moves roll back in tests.

chunks.title: Mobile board search & filter
chunks.summary: Client-side text search and label filter over the cards of the open board.
chunks.doneWhen: Search and label filters narrow the visible cards of the open board without backend calls.

chunks.title: Mobile auth connect
chunks.summary: Real auth data source on the generated client, secure token storage, authenticated HTTP pipeline with refresh-on-expiry, logout, and session-gated navigation.
chunks.doneWhen: Register, login, auto-refresh and logout work against the local backend.

chunks.title: Mobile boards connect
chunks.summary: Real boards/columns data sources and mapping; board list and board view wired to the backend and to each other in navigation.
chunks.doneWhen: Board and column flows work against the local backend.

chunks.title: Mobile labels connect
chunks.summary: Real labels data source and mapping; label management wired into navigation.
chunks.doneWhen: Label management works against the local backend.

chunks.title: Mobile cards connect
chunks.summary: Real cards data source; card detail hosted in the board view, drag & drop moves persisted, labels attached via the picker.
chunks.doneWhen: Card CRUD, drag & drop moves and label attach work against the local backend.

chunks.title: Mobile import/export connect
chunks.summary: Real import/export calls wired to the file handling, hosted in the board list.
chunks.doneWhen: Exporting a board and importing the file works against the local backend.

chunks.title: Web scaffolding & architecture
chunks.summary: React + TypeScript project, build tooling, isolated feature folder structure, routing, data-fetching setup, app-wide utilities (result/error types, logging), core domain models (Board, Column, Card, Label, User, text-length counting and field limits), responsive app shell, lint/test and CI.
chunks.doneWhen: App builds and runs with a responsive shell and routing; CI lints, tests and produces a static build.
